basic_details.job_title: JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary position of Scientific Administrative Assistant is open at the Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR), Bengaluru, an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, under Advt. No. NCU-EMR-186. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a Master's degree in Chemistry (preferable), aged up to 35 years, must send the filled application form with documents and a brief resume by email to [email protected] latest by 3 December 2026.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or Master's degree in Chemistry (Preferable). Desirable qualification: Candidates having experience in materials chemistry lab, inorganic chemistry lab, and catalysis lab. Maximum age limit: 35 years. The notice does not give an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Remuneration: Rs.20,000 plus applicable HRA. Higher salary: Three years' experience in similar job can get a higher salary. The notice does not state the higher amount. | For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

selection_process: The JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant selection has two stages
as printed in the instructions to candidates:
Shortlisting: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview. Online interview: Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview by a selection committee.
The notice does not mention a written test.

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: JNCASR is located at Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka. Its letterhead describes it as an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed-to-be-University.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post go by email only to [email protected] . They must be sent latest by 3 December 2026 . The notice does not print a time for the deadline. Candidates must use the application form in the Template, which the notice says is available on the website. They then send the duly filled form with the documents listed under Enclosures below. The notice does not specify a subject line for the email.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 temporary position of Scientific Administrative Assistant under Advt. No. NCU-EMR-186.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application must be sent to [email protected] latest by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a Master's degree in Chemistry (Preferable). Experience in materials chemistry lab, inorganic chemistry lab, and catalysis lab is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.20,000 plus applicable HRA. Candidates with three years' experience in a similar job can get a higher salary.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.20,000 remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the remuneration as Rs.20,000 plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form in the Template available on the website and email it with copies of original testimonials and a brief resume to [email protected] by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, and selection will be based on performance in that interview before a selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JNCASR Scientific Administrative Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a temporary position in the sponsored project "National Centre for Carbon Capture and Utilization (NCCCU) DST-JNCASR/SCP/4696B".

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes, those in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer. This applies only to outside candidates.
